europe_now.title: Russian Travel Curbs Proposed
europe_now.summary: The European Union is considering new travel restrictions for Russian citizens to counter potential hybrid security threats. Officials emphasize that tightening passport and visa controls is necessary to safeguard the bloc.

sources.headline: Russians face EU travel curbs to prevent hybrid attacks

europe_now.title: Zaporizhzhia Strike Casualties
europe_now.summary: A recent Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia resulted in the deaths of at least twenty people. Emergency services continue to respond to the devastation caused by the heavy bombardment in the region.

sources.headline: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 20 people

top_stories.title: Ukraine Energy Infrastructure Disputes
top_stories.summary: Ukrainian leadership stated preparedness to cease refinery strikes if Moscow halts attacks on energy infrastructure. Meanwhile, friction persists over ongoing aerial bombardments and diesel-related discussions.

sources.headline: Ukraine ready to halt refinery strikes if Moscow stops energy attacks, Zelensky says

top_stories.title: Spanish Electoral Campaigns Begin
top_stories.summary: Political leaders in Spain have officially launched their respective election campaigns across the country. These political events are currently being overshadowed by widespread public demonstrations concerning housing crises.
